says.notes: 2 Samuel 3:4 and 1 Chronicles 3:3 name her as the mother of David's son Shephatiah and do not call her his wife, so she may have been his concubine.

rulings.why: 'And the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital': Abital, David's wife, marked as one who may have been his concubine.
